text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Yaeno Muteki has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm cleaning my office when I happen to
notice an
open envelope sitting on a
corner of my desk.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, the prize from the raffle. You
should put
it to good use, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You remember that? It was such an
offhand
promise, I figured you would've
forgotten...
choice_data_list: Wait, didn't we say we'd use it to...
Wait, didn't we say we'd use it to...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki mentioned treating the
hot spring vacation as a new training
opportunity, but I'm
not going to let
that happen.
choice_data_list: Oh, but it's for hot spring therap...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She already trains too much as it is. I
want to
make sure she actually gets
some rest at the hot
spring.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh, understood. Let's take it easy,
then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're blessed with clear skies for the
trip, and even though she doesn't say it,
I can tell that
Yaeno Muteki is enjoying
the outing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was relaxing. All the tension
in my
muscles is gone and my body feels
lighter.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You certainly look well rested. And your
posture
is—
choice_data_list: Aah, my shoulders and lower back f...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm? Your posture is still unbalanced...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's see if we can fix that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We relocate to the beach near the inn.
Yaeno Muteki has me do some stretches,
then checks my
balance standing on one
leg, among other things.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good. You seem fine as far as I can tell.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's true.
But all I'm doing is using the

knowledge I gained from you.
choice_data_list: It feels refreshing to do the oppo...
It feels refreshing to do the oppo...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think of it, you've taught me
quite a
lot.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You know...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Considering how difficult I can be, it's
incredible
you haven't given up on me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm truly impressed by your patience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only have I never felt that she was a
bother, I
can't recall ever having to force
myself to put up
with her.
choice_data_list: ...I've never thought of you as a ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her what a hard worker she's been
and how I appreciate that she's always
responded to my
instructions with such
earnestness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I've just realized why I'm so docile in
your
presence, despite my wild
temperament.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's because...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You're an individual of unparalleled
virtue.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Considering that I've had the greatest
trainer of
all by my side the entire time,
then... Yes, it all
makes sense now!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not in the slightest! You ought to be
more
conscious of your own worth.
choice_data_list: You're giving me way too much cred...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It won't be long before people take
notice of
your noble nature and—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But wait, that's not a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You are utterly indispensable to me.
There's no
one else who can keep me in
check.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how desperately others may
plead for
your guidance, I cannot let you
yield to them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you grinning like that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to stay mum on the topic since
she's still
unaware. No doubt she'll try to
deflect things the moment she realizes
the real reason.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm... So you really won't tell me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then let's do some katas.
Perhaps that
way I can learn what you're
hiding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When it was decided that Yaeno Muteki
and I were to work together as racer and
trainer, she tried her best to convey her
feelings to me through a display of
martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she wants us to express our feelings
and deepen
our understanding of each
other, then I'll gladly
oblige.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Now, let's begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Yaeno Muteki and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
